scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight through a dark urban 4-way intersection while multiple adversarial vehicles execute turning maneuvers from the left and right arms.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection while following a front vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection ahead of the ego vehicle.
The car executes a left turn from the left arm of the intersection.
The car turns left from the right arm of the intersection.
The car turns right from the right arm of the intersection.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is positioned on a straight road approaching a 4-way intersection, with a front vehicle ahead in the same lane, a left-turning vehicle approaching from the left arm, and two vehicles on the right arm making left and right turns respectively.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must navigate through the intersection while maintaining safe distance from the front vehicle and avoiding conflicts with cross-traffic from the left and right arms; the scenario terminates once the ego has cleared the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the camera-host vehicle from first-person perspective; four non-ego vehicles are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: front straight vehicle, left-turning vehicle, left-turning vehicle from right arm, right-turning vehicle from right arm => adversarials length 4. 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches intersection behind front vehicle with others visible at arms; midpoint all vehicles enter intersection with complex crossing paths; ending ego and front vehicle exit straight while others complete turns. 4. Evidence: front vehicle maintains straight trajectory ahead of ego; left arm vehicle's headlights arc across from left to right; right arm vehicles' headlights show diverging left and right turn paths across frames.
